value: Substantially all of cost of revenue consists of compute and infrastructure costs associated with customer-serving workloads
quote: Substantially all of cost of revenue consists of compute and infrastructure costs associated with customer-serving workloads. Additionally, cost of revenue includes certain personnel-related costs and allocated overhead costs. (2) Research and development expenses primarily consist of compute and infrastructure costs associated with model development, research, and internal usage workloads, personnel-related costs, software expenses, and allocated overhead costs. (3) Sales and marketing expenses primarily consist of channel partner costs, marketing and advertising, personnel-related costs, compute and infrastructure costs associated with providing free access to the Company’s intelligence service, and allocated overhead costs. (4) General and administrative expenses primarily consist of the Company’s donation matching obligation, personnel-related costs, facility costs, allocated overhead costs, legal fees, and non-income-based taxes.
